title: Exercise the production federation stdio control bridge with a child process
outcome: A two-process fixture verifies the production pipe-to-control bridge, bounded buffering, EOF propagation and thread cleanup through FederationSshProcess control-stream ownership.
acceptance: An isolated child supplies piped stdin/stdout to federation_stdio_control and take_control_stream; proof, directional IO, EOF on child/local close and owned thread/process cleanup are observed without real SSH.
